evidence_summary: Current official careers page states KrossUp evaluates applications and collaborations for front-end and back-end development. Official studio pages confirm web development, ecommerce, maintenance, performance and technical production in Bari.
why_high_value: Strong agency-production overlap across frontend, web development, ecommerce, maintenance, performance and UX/UI; a current collaboration route exists, creating meaningful recurring-partner potential.
verified_facts: Official careers page explicitly says applications and collaborations are evaluated for front-end and back-end development.
Official studio is in Bari, Puglia.
Official services include web development, ecommerce, website maintenance and performance.
inferences: The page does not explicitly state freelance/P.IVA/agency subcontracting terms.
safe_alternative_angles: Use the official careers form and describe an external collaboration profile truthfully without claiming that KrossUp is currently seeking freelancers.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not claim a freelance/P.IVA opening that is not explicitly stated.
Use the official careers form rather than general info@ email for an application.
Do not upload or attach any CV unless the exact file satisfies the attachment approval protocol.
recommended_human_checks: Confirm form accepts an external-collaboration profile.
Review any CV upload requirement against the attachment approval registry.
If considering a B2B partner angle instead of application, verify a separate authoritative partnership/business route first.
